predictions_written_before_running.P2-1: Guard rows: on the 9a2b1d99e lines the agent overlay is unmapped before a background click and is mapped by the click's cursor reveal while the guard watches, so focus_guard mapped_popups() counts it as a new popup. When the steal is seen the guard reports focus_outcome=grab_held and does not restore. Prediction: OWN-20P R1 (G0m''), OWN-20Q R1m (G0'') and DLG (GQ'') restore gates FAIL; the U0 silent-miss positive controls still hold or turn into grab_held receipts (not silent misses). This is falsifiable: if the overlay is already mapped when the guard snapshots, the gates hold.
predictions_written_before_running.P2-2: Normal (no-steal) rows: no focus change, so no restore is attempted; tasks verified 40/40 is expected to hold; the false-restore counter depends on whether the analysis counts a grab_held receipt text as a focus_outcome (reported either way).
predictions_written_before_running.P2-3: Timing rows (R2-10R, N-04): verdicts and S directions are expected to hold; the map transition adds one X round trip on the overlay thread.

locks_and_timing.timing_rows: R2-10R scripted + native and N-04 measured blocks run in EXCLUSIVE windows: the runner waits until the cargo-build lock is free, then bin/quiet-timed fresh07-<chunk> flock -w 60 <cargo-build.lock> timeout -k 15 900 <private session>. A round starts only at 1-minute loadavg <= 4.0 (else re-read every second for up to 60 s, then the chunk ends and resumes later). AB/BA (Williams) order as in the original plans; every trial kept; failed sessions kept and re-run under a new label.
locks_and_timing.non_timing_rows: smoke, controls, OWN-20P and OWN-20Q blocks: SHARED quiet-lane lock with receipts (the original run_all.sh for the guard rows).
